# Third-party browser assets

The presentation vendors these browser libraries so the deck remains usable
without a package manager, CDN, network connection, or local server.

## KaTeX 0.18.1

- Project: <https://katex.org/>
- Source: <https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX>
- License: MIT (`katex/LICENSE`)
- Included: browser bundle, auto-render helper, CSS, and local fonts

## SVG.js 3.2.7

- Project: <https://svgjs.dev/>
- Source: <https://github.com/svgdotjs/svg.js>
- License: MIT (`svgjs/LICENSE`)
- Included: minified browser bundle and source map

## Newsreader

- Project: Newsreader typeface
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- License file: `../design-system/fonts/OFL-Newsreader.txt`
- Included: local variable and optical-size font files used for display text

## IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono

- Project: IBM Plex typeface family
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1
- License file: `../design-system/fonts/OFL-IBMPlex.txt`
- Included: local variable sans-serif and static monospace font files
